status: Replaces the rejected all-trailing pursuit model from 910ec92; apply this correction together with its prerequisite.
root_cause: Treating every coverage player as already trailing erased all outside contain angles. Speed-only closing then left the punter as the only practical remaining defender.
changes: Model a return lane and two outside contain positions separately from the cleared first wave.
Solve actual reachable interception distance using lateral separation, initial leverage, reaction, speed and pursuit.
Use each distinct defender once; a missed or already-passed defender is not recreated in front.
Allow the punter to approach with his own speed and tackling attributes.
Punt-only initial-lane chance base rises from .045 to .080 because it now exposes outside containment instead of treating the coverage unit as beaten. No touchdown quota or ordinary-distance boost.
tests: 86 focused tests passed; interception geometry, slower contain vs faster runner, impossible angles, delayed reactions, coverage order/duplicates, stronger tackling, already-passed punter, drive scoring/try, penalties, save/reload.
individual_review: CB, MIKE and WILL containment stops inspected; 64 TDs beat a reachable coverage defender. Detailed names and paths: punt-containment-players.json.
coordination: Changes (2) confirmed no shared pursuit helpers or source-function overlap. game.py changes are disjoint; merge hunks and regenerate web artifacts from combined sources.
limitations: Conditional field geometry is a modeling assumption, not NFL tracking coordinates.
Controlled punt origins and saved rosters; the frequency sample omits return penalties and injuries. Those paths have focused tests.
No claim of completed full-season calibration.
